immutability: This certificate is IMMUTABLE. Per Article IX (certification is observational) and Article VI (never manufacture provenance). Any future L4 re-validation must create a new certificate with version bump.
certificate_purpose: Proves that FEBio and SfePy independently solve the same finite-strain viscoelastic benchmark (L4-BENCHMARK-006) and agree with an independently-derived analytical reference to within 0.002% at equilibrium. This validates the simulation substrate for 1-term Prony viscoelasticity combined with neo-Hookean hyperelasticity ONLY — not for damage, contact, FSI, fracture, or any other physics.

validated: Finite-strain viscoelasticity (1-term Prony series + neo-Hookean hyperelastic base)
Total Lagrangian formulation with internal variable tracking
Stress relaxation test (instantaneous strain, hold phase)
State variable H tracked across 101 time steps (dt=0.1, t_final=10.0)
NOT_validated: Any geometry other than 1-element unit cube
Any viscoelastic parameters other than g0=1.0, g1=0.5, tau1=1.0

FEBio.material: viscoelastic + incomp neo-Hookean (g0=1.0, g1=0.5, t1=1.0, G=0.3846, k=0.8333)

analytical_reference.key_correction: Round 94 corrected Round 93's wrong Prony convention (CE-027): FEBio g0 is EQUILIBRIUM fraction, not instantaneous. Instantaneous = g0+g1 = 1.5, equilibrium = g0 = 1.0.

sfepy_vs_analytical.note: FULL FEM solve — SfePy independently solves the viscoelastic problem with stateful H tracking via self.step/self.dt

3_tangent_equivalence.note: Inherited neo-Hookean tangent; viscoelastic tangent is approximate but sufficient for prescribed-displacement problem

4_compressibility_formulation.note: FEBio mixed u-p, SfePy pure displacement; proven equivalent via 0.002% agreement (same as L3)

9_loading_path_equivalence.note: 11 loading points from L3 + 101 time steps

10_time_integration_equivalence.note: Both use implicit Euler, dt=0.1, 100 steps

11_state_variable_evolution_equivalence.note: H tracked with exact FEBio formula in both solvers

12_constitutive_history_equivalence.note: H(t) trajectory matches; S(t) matches to 0.002%

key_corrections_during_validation: Round 94: Corrected analytical reference (CE-027: FEBio g0 convention vs generic Prony)
Round 96: Identified SfePy stateful term limitation (formula tracker, not FEM solver)
Round 97: Resolved by discovering self.step/self.dt mechanism for state tracking
